inputs.text: Cuba appears to be heading toward some kind of political transition. Some Cubans fear residents own nothing and are too poor to take over the few businesses still operating on the island, leaving the wealthy, sizable diaspora—and possibly foreign investors—able to swoop in and buy property and businesses at bargain prices.
